title: vitis sylvestris subsp. anebophylla
intro: Vitis sylvestris subsp. anebophylla, commonly known as wild grapevine, is a plant species belonging to the family Vitaceae. The health benefits of Vitis sylvestris subsp. anebophylla include its ability to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Vitis sylvestris subsp. anebophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
